isolation.note: Verified against OpenCode 1.18.31 (verified live during development): OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is honored as an inline config override; tools.{"*": false} disables every tool, permission.{"*": "deny"} denies execution, plugin [] and --pure drop plugins, mcp {} drops MCP servers, and a live probe confirmed the model can emit no executing tool calls. Residual limitation: OpenCode merges user-global config (~/.config/opencode) and managed settings that this harness cannot un-merge, so globally declared plugins/MCP servers may still be loaded (their execution remains denied). Claim: denied tool EXECUTION in a fresh session and fresh temp cwd; NOT a hermetic sandbox.

objective: minimize total DMA input bytes, then command count

model.cwd_policy: fresh system-temp directory outside the repository

proposal.rationale: Weight-stationary engine, DIM=16 tiles. N=80 gives 5 column blocks (loop i over N//16); K=32 gives two 16-wide chunks processed in increasing K order to satisfy the ordered-reduction contract: chunk 0 (A cols 0-15, B rows 0-15) overwrites accumulator rows 0-15, chunk 1 (A cols 16-31 at A offset 16, B rows 16-31 at B offset 1280+i*16) accumulates. Scratchpad holds exactly two tiles: A tile at spad row 0, staged B tile at spad row 16 (both 16-row, within 32 rows), reloaded per iteration since A0/A1 and B tiles cannot all stay resident in 32 rows. Accumulator rows 0-15 are reused per block and drained with mvout (C offset i*16, row stride 320 = 80 int32 bytes) before the next block, so mvout always follows initialized contents. out_addr 2684354560 sets bit 31 (accumulator) + bit 29 (full width) with overwrite; 3758096384 additionally sets bit 30 for accumulate. Traffic: 10 A tiles + 10 B tiles = 5120 DMA input bytes, the minimum given the 2-tile scratchpad, and 50 expanded commands.

proposal.rationale: Key improvement over round 1: use both accumulator tiles (rows 0-15 and 16-31) to keep two column blocks live simultaneously, pairing blocks (0,1) and (2,3) in a loop over p (block a=2p, b=2p+1) plus a final flat block 4. Within a pair, compute order is c0a (A0*B0a overwrite acc rows 0-15), c0b (A0*B0b overwrite acc rows 16-31), c1a (A1*B1a accumulate rows 0-15), c1b (A1*B1b accumulate rows 16-31). A0 stays resident at spad row 0 across both chunk-0 computes (one A0 load serves two blocks) and A1 likewise serves both chunk-1 computes, so each pair needs only 6 mvins instead of 8. Per-block K order is preserved: chunk 0 (A cols 0-15, B rows 0-15) overwrites, chunk 1 (A offset 16, B offset 1280+16*block) accumulates, satisfying the ordered-reduction contract; disjoint accumulator tiles keep the two blocks independent. Spad uses exactly rows 0-15 (A slot) and 16-31 (B slot); all tile starts are multiples of 16 within the 32-row capacities. Every compute is immediately preceded by its own preload with accumulated=false and bd_spad_addr=4294967295, matching the accepted round-1 pattern; accumulate-mode computes and all mvouts follow initialized accumulator contents. out_addr values set bit 31 (accumulator) + bit 29 (full width), plus bit 30 for accumulate, with low bits 0 or 16 selecting the accumulator tile; mvout acc_addr uses the same layout. C offsets are 16*block with store stride 320 bytes (80 int32 per row). Totals: 16 mvins (6 A + 10 B, each B tile loaded exactly once) = 4096 DMA input bytes versus 5120 in round 1, and 46 expanded commands (2x16 loop body + 9 final block + 4 configs + 1 fence).

proposal.rationale: Resubmission of the accepted round-2 stream, which is Pareto-optimal under the stated objective. DMA input bytes are minimal: B contributes exactly 10 distinct 16x16 tiles (2 k-chunks x 5 n-blocks), each loaded once = 2560 bytes; A has only 2 distinct tiles but the 32-row scratchpad fits just two 16-row tiles, so a B tile always occupies one slot and an A tile the other. Since only 2 accumulator tiles (32 rows) exist, at most two k=0 partial sums can be live, so one A0 load can serve at most 2 chunk-0 computes before A1 must be loaded for their chunk-1 accumulates; hence ceil(5/2)=3 loads each of A0 and A1 = 6 A tiles = 1536 bytes. Total 16 mvins x 256 = 4096 bytes, provably minimal. Command count is also minimal at 46: 10 computes (2 per n-block, mandatory for K=32) each require exactly one preload (10), 5 mvouts cover C (16x80 = 5 tiles, cols/rows fixed at 16), 16 mvins, 4 configs (config_ex must precede compute, config_st must precede mvout, both DMA streams configured), and 1 final fence. Structure: loop p over N//32 pairs blocks a=2p, b=2p+1; per pair the order is c0a, c0b (A0 at spad 0 resident, B tiles streamed to spad 16, overwrite into acc rows 0-15 and 16-31 via out_addr 0xA0000000/0xA0000010), then A1 loaded, then c1a, c1b (accumulate via out_addr 0xE0000000/0xE0000010), then both accumulator tiles drained with mvout to C offsets 32p and 32p+16 (row stride 320 bytes). Per-block K order (chunk 0 overwrite, chunk 1 accumulate) satisfies the ordered-reduction contract; every compute is immediately preceded by its own preload with accumulated=false and bd_spad_addr=4294967295; all scratchpad/accumulator starts are multiples of 16 within the 32-row capacities; block 4 is handled flat after the loop. Each compute uses the B tile staged by the immediately preceding preload, and the two accumulator tiles keep paired blocks independent.
